_comment: Component height above the board, mm, keyed by footprint library id. Measured from each footprint's STEP model (VERTEX_POINT geometry, with the footprint's own scale/rotate applied), NOT from datasheets. null = unknown; score.py will warn and treat Z as a lower bound. Verify the tallest few by hand - they set your Z, and every mm of error is (board area) mm3 of score error.

_verify.pcbgolf:DCJACK_2MM_SMT: sets Z today. STEP model has a Z offset - hand-fitted, so check PJ-002AH-SMT-TR datasheet.
_verify.pcbgolf:USB-C-FEMALE-VERT-GCT: VERTICAL receptacle, 10.1mm. A horizontal SMT USB-C is ~3.2mm for the same mating plug.
_verify.pcbgolf:0472192001: STEP model has a Z offset; verify.
_verify.pcbgolf:CHOKE-3.2X2.5: STEP model has a Z offset; verify.
_verify.pcbgolf:DX07S024XJ1R1100: STEP model has a Z offset; verify.
_verify.pcbgolf:2X04: no 3D model. THT 2.54mm header ~8.5mm above board; SMD right-angle far less.
_verify.pcbgolf:M2_BOLT: no 3D model. Mounting hole - 0 if unpopulated, bolt head if not.
